description: Fine-grained reactive component framework (sigx) — signals, components, router, store, SSG, SSR, native iOS/Android (Lynx), and terminal UIs. Docs source for https://sigx.dev
rules: signal(primitive) returns { value: T } — read and write via .value (count.value++)
signal(object) and signal(array) return a deep reactive proxy — direct property access (user.name = 'Jane'), never .value
$set() exists only on object/array signals and replaces the whole value; primitives assign .value instead
component() setup runs once and returns a render closure; put reactive reads inside the returned () => JSX, and call slots optionally (slots.default?.())
Install the umbrella package only (sigx, or @sigx/lynx / @sigx/terminal per platform) — never @sigx/reactivity or @sigx/runtime-* directly
